title: Spicy Chicken Paella
description: A Thai twist on the classic Spanish dish, this spicy chicken paella is a flavorful and aromatic meal perfect for a dinner party.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large paella pan or skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken to the pan and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the pan and set aside.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil to the pan and sauté the onion and bell pepper until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the paella seasoning and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the chicken broth to the pan and bring to a boil.
Add the rice to the pan and stir to coat with the broth.
Add the chicken back to the pan and stir to combine.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.
Stir in the coconut milk and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro if desired.
